name: Apple Dev
tagline: Runs Xcode, simulators and Swift builds on a Mac you have connected
description: Aimed at people whose work has to compile on Apple hardware. Point it at a machine you have already paired, by its identifier, and it drives the local toolchain sitting there, editor, build, simulator, so the iOS or macOS side of a project is handled from chat rather than by hand.
author: Baconbrix
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
